task_text: Mine a coal block. There are dark black coal blocks directly in front of you. Use the wooden pickaxe in your inventory to mine one of them.

The air fill removes any tree obstructions in the immediate area. A wooden pickaxe is sufficient to mine coal blocks (confirmed via wiki - mining level 0 handles coal blocks). The player needs to walk ~4 blocks forward and mine any of the 3 coal blocks. Validator confirmed via /clear that the player starts with 0 coal_block items, so the milestone is not pre-satisfied.
